title: Headless sprint loop 1: worker brief and role file
goal: A worker makes no git worktree of its own and kb-worker.md names the worker's scratch directory (ST-yztru4mz); kb-worker names the open choices that need a gate and lists every consumer of a changed function before it changes it (ST-p3uah3o3); a research task or subtask gets --max-turns 200 (ST-php5itob); a worker's /kb-verify run does not run tests.py --changed (ST-nlxo2zv5); the land and retry steps resume a headless worker with claude -p --resume, and the orchestrator's own-session landing names backlog.py land (ST-yk7wwfg3); the orchestrator records an operator's gate answer on a worker branch by a documented route (ST-mxuwtgqx); briefs and gate questions give measured figures with their command, and the sprint reviewer runs in a worktree of its own with a named launch (ST-2ldhug4l)
